scope: Public official geometry and survey availability for the approved Kyoto route's Shijo Bridge pedestrian deck and Nishiki/Shinkyogoku covered-passage floor
qualification: No additional source inspected in this bounded investigation establishes reusable measured deck or covered-floor geometry. These remain measured-surface acquisition gaps, subject to the parent's direct CityGML and decoded-road intersection results.
limitations: A bounded public-source lookup cannot establish that no survey exists.
Source publication or HTTP modification dates are separate from geometry capture dates.
The city road-information service advertises plan dimensions and control-point positions; the page itself supplies no measured pedestrian floor elevations.
The union's published street width and total length do not establish local floor grade, level changes, entrances, or a vertical datum.
No Shinkyogoku floor survey, reusable measured bridge deck, or open license for such geometry was established.
No operator, city official, vendor, or other person was contacted.

findings.location: Kyoto City managed roads; site-specific plan and control-point content must be identified separately
findings.rights: City policy requires permission for reproduction or reuse beyond legally permitted private use or quotation. No 3D geometry reuse license established.
facts: The city advertises road-ledger plans containing traffic-width and gutter dimensions and grade 1-4 survey-control-point numbers and positions.
The city says online information may lag current records; current information is available through its Road Boundary Clarification Section.
Certified road-ledger plan copies cost JPY 350 each; no copies were purchased.
findings.nextAcquisitionRequirement: If supplied as a source option, request existing Shijo deck/sidewalk cross-sections and covered-floor survey coordinates with capture date, vertical datum, accuracy and explicit commercial derivative/redistribution rights. No request is authorized or sent by this investigation.

findings.sourceDate: Union membership count dated 2026-05; capture-policy pages undated; filming DOCX HTTP Last-Modified 2024-11-29, document policy date unspecified
findings.location: Nishikikoji Street between Takakura and Teramachi, Kyoto; operator describes approximately 390 m of street
findings.method: Full HTML page inspection and OOXML text extraction with Python ZipFile and lxml
findings.rights: Operator website requires permission for reproduction and alteration outside legally allowed use. Filming conditions do not grant blanket commercial 3D reconstruction or model distribution rights.
facts: The operator describes a roughly 390 m street, generally 3.3 m wide with some sections over 5 m.
The contact page requests filming and reporting applications at least one month in advance; individual shop arrangements follow the application.

The filming guidance prohibits installed lighting and large equipment, discourages selfie sticks and tripods, and asks visitors to preserve circulation and avoid prolonged fixed-position recording during crowds.
The guidance asks photographers to avoid recording other customers/staff and to obtain consent before publishing identifiable visitors.
findings.nextAcquisitionRequirement: A permitted small handheld floor/entrance survey must explicitly include metric scale control, shared vertical reference, participant privacy and rights to publish the resulting commercial 3D model. The operator's one-month application lead time must be included in the acquisition proposal.
